svg.title: nilssonia-culgower-250480 - original atlas schematic
svg.desc: Original educational schematic; not a photograph or exact reconstruction. Original detached segmented cycad-like leaf schematic for the leaf form genus Nilssonia, not a whole plant, a modern cycad, a scan of the Sutherland fossil or a species-level diagnosis of N. brevis; the rachis is drawn exposed for readability rather than partly covered by the lamina. The Kimmeridgian age envelope does not date this leaf exactly to 150 Ma or establish continuous existence.
